title: Length of an encoded list of words
statement: For any finite list $L$ of finite bit strings, concatenating the self-delimiting encodings of each word in $L$ paired with the empty word produces a bit string of length exactly $\sum_{w\in L}(2|w|+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of finite bit strings
